name: scss-alias-jump
description: Bidirectional jump between SCSS and React/Vue/Svelte. CSS Modules support (importName.className ↔ .className). SCSS @use/@forward/@import with aliases. Interpolation #{$var} support.

commands.title: SCSS Alias Jump: Debug Scan Imports (@use/@forward/@import)
SCSS Alias Jump: Open Import Under Cursor
SCSS Alias Jump: Debug Click Test (Show Range Info)
SCSS Alias Jump: Clear Internal Caches

scssAliasJump.debugLogging.markdownDescription: Enable verbose debug logging to the Output panel (can be noisy).

scssAliasJump.hoverWorkspaceScan.markdownDescription: Enable workspace scans for hover features (class usages / %placeholder @extend references). Disable if experiencing 'Loading...' delays in very large projects.

scssAliasJump.aliases.markdownDescription: Map import aliases to absolute paths (can use VS Code variables like `${workspaceFolder}` or `${workspaceFolder:folderName}`). Explicit aliases win. Without an explicit match, `@/…` falls back to `${workspaceFolder}/src/…` and `@scss/…` falls back to `${workspaceFolder}/vendor/_assets/scss/…`. Example: `{ "@": "${workspaceFolder:nlrc}/src", "@scss": "${workspaceFolder:_assets}/scss" }`

scssAliasJump.scanExclude.markdownDescription: Additional workspace-scan exclude globs applied after VS Code default excludes. Use this to skip generated folders in very large projects.

scssAliasJump.scanMaxFileSizeKB.markdownDescription: Maximum file size, in KB, that SCSS Alias Jump reads during workspace scans. Larger files are skipped to keep hover/definition responsive.

scssAliasJump.scanMaxFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum number of candidate files considered per workspace scan before post-filtering and result limits are applied.

scssAliasJump.cacheAutoClearIntervalMs.markdownDescription: Automatically clears SCSS Alias Jump's internal path/scan caches on this interval, in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable periodic clearing. Hung scans are still hard-timeout guarded.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:parser
